section_header: A340E (2JZ-GTE) AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION - COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION
title: INSTALL SECOND COAST BRAKE COVER, PISTON ASSEMBLY AND SPRING
ocr_text:
AT-96
A340E (2JZ-GTE)  AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION  -  COMPONENT PARTS INSTALLATION

18.  INSTALL SECOND COAST BRAKE COVER, PISTON
ASSEMBLY AND SPRING
(a)  Coat 2 new O-rings with ATF and install them to the cover.
(b)  Install the spring, piston assembly and cover to the case.

AT5086

(c)  Using SST, install the snap ring.
SST 09350-30020  (09350-07060)

SST

AT5127

19.  CHECK PISTON ROD STROKE OF SECOND COAST
BRAKE
(a)  Place a mark on the second coast brake piston rod.

Mark

AT5216

(b)  Using SST, measure the stroke while applying and releas-
ing compressed air (392-785 kPa, 4-8 kgf/cm2 or 57-114
psi).
SST 09240-00020
Piston rod stroke:
1.0-2.0 mm (0.039-0.079 in.)
If the stroke is more than specified, replace the piston rod
with a longer one.
Piston rod length:
70.7 mm (2.783 in.)
71.4 mm (2.811 in.)
72.2 mm (2.843 in.)
72.9 mm (2.870 in.)
73.7 mm (2.902 in.)
If it is still more than standard value, replace the brake
band with a new one.

SST

AT5217
